message.content: {"verdict":"revise","score":0.55,"reasons":["Multiple items lack an explicit article timestamp (only one item includes a timestamp). The spec requires a timestamp for each story.","Several primary_source_url fields point to archive or index pages rather than the direct article's page (e.g., Indian Express archive URLs and The Indian Express/archive/2026/09/06) which violates 'direct URL' requirement.","One item uses a generic Reuters landing page rather than a specific article URL, making it hard to verify exact content and timestamp.","Some entries rely on archive listings and not the latest developing status; ensure items flagged as developing reflect current article status with a live timestamp."],"guidance":"Rebuild the brief as a clean 5–8-story JSON array. For each story, include: a one-sentence headline, 1–2 sentence context, primary source name, a direct URL to the article, and the exact publication timestamp in ISO 8601. Ensure the timestamp is present for all items. Use current reputable outlets and avoid archive/index pages. Mark items as developing only if the article itself indicates ongoing updates, otherwise set developing to false. Do not include extra fields like timestamp_note or verification_status unless specified."}
